title: Interview opening and the Keppard name
summary: Interviewer notes place and date; Keppard gives his name and says he is brother of Freddie Keppard.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: I'll make a note on here that we're interviewing Mr. Louis Kepard at his home at 1017 North Villary, is that right? That's right. And the date is January the 19th, 1961. And you might give your full name if you have a middle name.
You pronounce that Kepard sort of a French accent.
K-E-P-A-R-D Kepard. It's the same name as Freddie Kepard. You see? Yes. Now, that's my oldest brother I had. I had four altogether, but the rest of the other two died while I was young.
